title: Pelican Sound vs. Stoneybrook, Estero FL: Which Is Right for You? 2026
excerpt: Pelican Sound charges every owner $11,495 a year for bundled golf; Stoneybrook charges nothing until you want to play, then $12,000 to $20,000 for an annual pass. We ran the 2026 numbers on both Estero communities to find the break-even.
